jacques_le_goff.label: Jacques Le Goff
jacques_le_goff.date_label: “Temps de l’Église et temps du marchand” (1960) · La Civilisation de l’Occident médiéval (1964) · La Naissance du Purgatoire: French original (1981) · The Birth of Purgatory: Arthur Goldhammer translation (1984)
jacques_le_goff.description: A medieval historian who connects representations, everyday conditions and social organization. Jean-Claude Schmitt’s account, reproduced in the EPHE institutional notice, describes his medieval synthesis as attentive to material vulnerability, gestures, towns and intellectual activity. His work on purgatory advances a historically specific account of an intermediate place in the afterlife; that chronology remains a thesis to assess. His essays on medieval temporalities also supplied an explicitly acknowledged resource for E. P. Thompson’s discussion of work discipline.
jacques_le_goff.representative_figures_and_works: “Au Moyen Âge: temps de l’Église et temps du marchand” (1960); La Civilisation de l’Occident médiéval (1964); La Naissance du Purgatoire (1981); The Birth of Purgatory, translated by Arthur Goldhammer (1984).
jacques_le_goff.scope_note: The monographs and Le Goff’s 1960/1963 essays are not newly read. Schmitt’s interpretation is attributed; Thompson’s p. 56 provides direct named-use testimony. The original Purgatory publisher/contents qualification remains. French originals and Goldhammer’s translation are distinct; no career interval or exclusive Annales identity.

alain_corbin.label: Alain Corbin
alain_corbin.date_label: Les Filles de noce (1978) · Le Miasme et la Jonquille (1982) · Le Monde retrouvé de Louis-François Pinagot (1998)
alain_corbin.description: A historian of sensory worlds and the socially overlooked. His interview explains how bells, smells and desired landscapes become historical objects, and why recovering an unknown rural person requires a different experiment from a biography built on self-authored testimony.
alain_corbin.representative_figures_and_works: Les Filles de noce (1978); Le Miasme et la Jonquille (1982); Le Monde retrouvé de Louis-François Pinagot (1998).

michael_b_katz.label: Michael B Katz
michael_b_katz.date_label: The Irony of Early School Reform (1968) · W.E.B. Du Bois, Race, and the City (co-edited with Thomas J. Sugrue) (1998) · The Price of Citizenship (updated edition) (2008)
michael_b_katz.description: A historian of education, cities and welfare who challenged moralized categories of poverty. His statements on poorhouses question the division between deserving and undeserving people and the belief that punitive institutions can eliminate dependence.

colin_g_calloway.label: Colin G Calloway
colin_g_calloway.date_label: One Vast Winter Count (2003) · The Scratch of a Pen (2006) · The Indian World of George Washington (2018)
colin_g_calloway.description: A historian who centres Native peoples within the history of North America. His Washington interview explains land acquisition, warfare and sovereignty as integral to the founding of the United States, while distinguishing his contextual history from a conventional great-man biography.
colin_g_calloway.representative_figures_and_works: One Vast Winter Count (2003); The Scratch of a Pen (2006); The Indian World of George Washington (2018).
